FAST

Nov 6 : Google has acquired Crusoe's data center site in southeast Wyoming, the AI infrastructure developer said on Friday, a day after the Alphabet unit announced a $17-billion investment in the project. Here are some details: • Google announced the investment on Thursday to build its first data center in Wyoming, expanding its AI infrastructure despite growing political opposition to such projects in parts of the US • Crusoe said it has completed its involvement in the project's pre-development phase, which included site selection, government approvals and power strategy

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（6日） 4:58 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。幅広い銘柄が売られた。ＦＴＳＥ１００種は週間ベースで０．５２％安と反落。米中間選挙での民主党圧勝を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）を巡る懸念が強まり、リスク回避の姿勢が広がった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は前日比０．８０％安、週間では０．２１％上昇した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種通信株指数は前日比３．５９％安。通信大手ＢＴグループは６．４％、エアテル・アフリカは４．０％、それぞれ下落した。

製薬・バイオテクノロジー株指数は０．５９％、生活必需品株指数は１．７０％、石油・ガス株指数は１．５７％いずれも下げた。

ヘッジファンド大手マン・グループは７．６％安。クウェートの年金基金との裁判で敗訴し、売り材料視された。

一方、貴金属株指数は１．６５％高だった。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

続落して取引を終えた。米中間選挙での民主党圧勝を受け、人工知能（ＡＩ）関連株の先行きを巡る懸念が強まり、投資家にリスク回避の姿勢が広がった。ドイツのＤＡＸ指数は１．９２％下落。ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種指数は週間ベースでは０．２４％上昇した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種保険株指数は前日比２．６１％安。ＪＰモルガンがドイツの再保険会社の投資判断を引き下げたことを受け、ハノーバー再保険は４．４％、ミュンヘン再保険は４．３％、それぞれ下落した。

テクノロジー株指数は０．１６％安と続落。メディア株指数は２．２６％、個人・家庭用品株指数は１．８９％それぞれ下落した。オフィス支援業務を手がけるフランスのテレパフォーマンスは１５．３％安と急落した。通期売上高見通しを引き下げ、売られた。

一方、米イランの戦闘終結に向けた気運が高まり原油価格が低下するとの期待感から、旅行・娯楽関連株指数は０．８５％上昇。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

域内国債利回りがほぼ横ばいで推移した。ただ、米ハイテク株の急落を受けて投資家が安全資産に逃避し、市場で欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）の利上げ観測が後退する中、週間ベースでは低下の見通しとなった。

ドイツ１０年債利回りは３．２５％と横ばい。一時、３．２０７５％と８月２６日以来の低水準を付けた。週間では７ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の見通しとなった。

フランス１０年債利回りは２ｂｐ低下。週間では２０ｂｐ低下の見通し。仏独１０年債利回り格差は１５２ｂｐと小幅に縮小した。

イタリア１０年債利回りは４．３４４％と横ばい。独伊１０年債利回り格差は１０８ｂｐとなった。

市場は、ＥＣＢの中銀預金金利が２０２７年終盤までに約３．０２％になると予想。１０月末の３．２５％から低下した。市場はまた、来月の理事会で約８０％の確率で利上げが実施されるとの見方を織り込んでいる。

FAST

SAO PAULO, Nov 6 : Ferrari held talks to clear the air after a costly clash between Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc at last weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, with team principal Frederic Vasseur saying the pair had now moved on and turned their focus to the Sao Paulo race. The meeting followed Hamilton’s public criticism of the opening-lap incident, which derailed Ferrari's hopes of a one-two finish, with the Briton saying again on Thursday that he remained frustrated by what had happened. "We did it yesterday evening," Vasseur told reporters at Interlagos on Friday. "It was good to discuss, good to clarify my position and their position. It was good to do, and now we turn the page and we are focusing on the next one." Leclerc, who became a father this week, arrived in Brazil on Thursday but missed the first practice session, with youngster Dino Beganovic standing in for the Monegasque.

Hamilton started from pole in Mexico but lost out after a battle with Leclerc through the opening corners forced both Ferraris off track, allowing race winner Max Verstappen to take advantage. The seven-times world champion said after the race that it was difficult when a "teammate works against you" and suggested Ferrari needed to revisit how their drivers raced one another. Vasseur said the team's expectations had not changed despite the flare-up. "The guidelines are still the same," he said. "They need to respect each other. They are two competitors with the fighting spirit for sure, but they need to have respect for the other one. But mainly, they need to respect the brand, the team." Vasseur also dismissed suggestions that differences in personality between Hamilton and Leclerc posed a broader problem for the Maranello-based team. "We have two experienced guys, two competitive guys... It's a choice in the lineup. I have the positive and the negative. I will deal with the negative. "I'm not asking them to be best friends. I think it's even probably a bit negative. I'm just asking them to act and to work as professionals," he added. The situation prompted a familiar reaction from Mercedes boss Toto Wolff, who likened the episode to the intense rivalry between Hamilton and Nico Rosberg during Mercedes' title-dominating years in the 2010s. "Fred here doesn't need any advice from me, but it's like a deja vu," Wolff said. "Sometimes it needs the really tough ones, like the last one, to make a point."

Source: Reuters

FAST

NEW YORK/LONDON, Nov 6 : Wall Street equities mostly rallied on Friday, reversing course after trillions of dollars of world stock market value was wiped out over fears that Democratic election victories this week would bring tighter US regulations for the AI industry. Benchmark S&P 500 and the Nasdaq were trading higher with technology, communication services and consumer discretionary stocks driving gains. The Dow edged lower on the day. All three indexes were on track for weekly losses following a brutal selloff in the prior session. The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.08 per cent, the S&P 500 rose 0.71 per cent, and the Nasdaq Composite gained 1.4 per cent. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was up 4.2 per cent after slumping in its biggest one-day drop since April 2025. Nvidia rose 3 per cent, after suffering its worst day since January 2025, when the emergence of low-cost Chinese AI model DeepSeek hammered markets.

Other heavyweight chipmakers, including AMD, Intel, and Micron Technology, were up between 5.5 per cent and 10 per cent, while Elon Musk's Tesla and SpaceX were also up 2 per cent and 8 per cent respectively after losses earlier this week. "Most of the disruption of the AI buildout will not probably occur but it's just the uncertainty of the change in government from Republican-led to Democratic-led, not only at the federal level but the state, local levels," said Gerry Sparrow, president and portfolio manager at Sparrow Capital Management. "That's causing some disruption in the expectations of investors... The volatility around elections or any political event, whether it be war or terrorist attack, is always going to disrupt the market." Texas' Democratic governor-elect Gina Hinojosa said on Thursday that the state — which already has a large share of US data centres — will introduce new laws to protect local communities from their further mass buildup. The jitters are hitting an AI trade already under pressure from fears that the massive cost of the data centres and other infrastructure will limit future returns, spurring margin calls and spooking retail investors and hedge funds alike. RIPPLE EFFECT The bounces were in stark contrast with market action in the rest of the world. Europe's STOXX 600 lost 1 per cent. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei and South Korea's KOSPI both slumped about 6 per cent. For the Nikkei — just like Wall Street the previous day — it was the biggest one-day drop since US President Donald Trump's "Liberation Day" trade tariff panic of April 2025. The MSCI All-World index fell 0.52 per cent while MSCI's broadest index of Asia-Pacific shares outside Japan lost 3 per cent. PAYROLLS BEAT FORECASTS US nonfarm payrolls, usually one of the most-focused on pieces of data, but largely overshadowed by the tech drama, showed a stronger-than-expected 165,000 pickup in jobs. An anticipated slowdown in annual wage growth to below 3 per cent for the first time in nearly 5-1/2 years did not materialise either as it came in at 3.1 per cent. The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note ticked up to 4.85 per cent, having dropped to its lowest level since September 9 overnight. In currencies, the dollar rose against major currencies including the euro, yen and Swiss franc. It was up 0.52 per cent against the yen and rose 0.47 per cent against the Swiss franc. The euro was down 0.68 per cent against the dollar at $1.1142. Brent crude prices tiptoed back up towards $100 a barrel, but are still set for their biggest weekly drop since 2020 on hopes the midterms' results might prompt Trump to de-escalate the Iran war. Spot gold fell 0.48 per cent to $4,067.75.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Más negocios, alquileres al alza y vuelven trabajadores: renacer petrolero de Venezuela se siente en El Tigre
item.description: El auge de actividad en esta ciudad situada en los límites de la Faja del Orinoco, un enorme depósito de crudo pesado similar al alquitrán, es un frágil reflejo del anunciado regreso petrolero de Vene ...
item.dc:creator: Fabiola Zerpa
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Si quiere ver pruebas del renacer petrolero de Venezuela, no se quede en Caracas. Debe ir más de seis horas en auto al sureste, a una ciudad llamada El Tigre. Aviones privados están aterrizando frecuentemente en el modesto aeropuerto a las afueras de la ciudad. Tras años en el extranjero, venezolanos regresan para trabajar en el creciente número de empresas de servicios y suministros que se expanden o se instalan allí. Queda poco espacio disponible en los modernos edificios de oficinas, mientras el valor de los alquileres de casas amuebladas ha aumentado 33% desde comienzos de año. Ver más: El euro cruza la barrera de los 1.000 bolívares y añade presión a los precios en Venezuela “En el año a octubre hemos duplicado el volumen de equipos enviados y triplicamos el número de empresas atendidas en comparación con febrero”, dijo Greg Díaz, director de la empresa de transporte Frontier Forwarders Inc., con sede en Texas. “Ya incorporamos un segundo barco para poder atender todos los encargos”. El estallido de actividad en esta ciudad situada en los límites de la Faja del Orinoco —un enorme depósito de crudo pesado similar al alquitrán— es un frágil reflejo del anunciado regreso petrolero de Venezuela. El entusiasmo por reanudar las perforaciones y rehabilitar pozos crece tras años de falta de inversión, sanciones y un éxodo de productores extranjeros. La cercanía de El Tigre a las operaciones existentes y su concentración de empresas de servicios petroleros la han convertido en uno de los primeros centros de este resurgimiento. El frenesí comenzó antes de que las empresas hayan extraído un solo barril adicional de petróleo. Las compañías arriendan oficinas y patios de almacenamiento, importan equipos, contratan personal e inspeccionan yacimientos para operaciones que, en muchos casos, aún tardarán meses en comenzar. Mientras tanto, los apagones siguen prolongándose durante horas. El incipiente despertar de El Tigre se produce después de que fuerzas estadounidenses capturaran a Nicolás Maduro en enero, lo que dio paso al ascenso de la presidenta interina Delcy Rodríguez. Su gobierno, respaldado por EE.UU., busca atraer capital extranjero y para eso reformó la ley petrolera este año, reduciendo impuestos y regalías y dando a las empresas privadas mayor margen para operar en áreas dominadas durante mucho tiempo por la estatal Petróleos de Venezuela SA, o PDVSA. Algunos comenzaron a apostar por una apertura mucho antes de la salida de Maduro. El operador turco de centrales eléctricas Çan2 Termik AS invirtió en 2024 en Denarius Pumping Services CA, una contratista con sede en El Tigre. En septiembre, su filial en Florida Denarius Holding Group Inc., a través de su unidad venezolana Minerosol Group CA, firmó un contrato con PDVSA para rehabilitar y perforar un yacimiento cercano como parte de un plan de inversión de US$400 millones. “Estamos acostumbrados a trabajar en mercados de frontera”, dijo Zehra Zeynep Dereli, vicepresidenta de Denarius Holding Group. “Hemos visto el enorme crecimiento que puede surgir con las inversiones y regulaciones adecuadas, y pensamos que podíamos replicarlo en Venezuela”. Ver más: Venezuela crecería 12,8% en 2027, pero su economía aún estaría lejos de recuperar los niveles de 2012 El petróleo ha marcado a El Tigre desde la década de 1930, cuando Standard Oil descubrió el característico crudo pesado de la Faja del Orinoco y el asentamiento se convirtió en un dinámico centro industrial. Hoy, la ciudad de unos 300.000 habitantes está rodeada de pozos, oleoductos e instalaciones de almacenamiento envejecidos. El crudo producido en la zona se transporta hacia el norte, a las instalaciones de procesamiento y exportación de PDVSA en la costa del Caribe. El Tigre está salpicado de estatuas del gran felino, incluida una célebre y poco agraciada escultura al borde de una carretera que se convirtió en meme nacional y posteriormente en un popular lugar para tomarse fotos. El tigre simboliza ahora una industria que nuevamente se prepara para saltar. Las petroleras que firmaron acuerdos con PDVSA en los últimos meses tienen hasta 120 días para inspeccionar yacimientos e instalaciones, evaluar las reservas restantes y los daños ambientales, y preparar planes de producción para su aprobación. Actualmente están trasladando equipos, trabajadores y dinero ante la expectativa de lo que vendrá. La carga llega desde distintas partes de EE.UU., incluidos Montana, Utah, Wyoming, Oklahoma, Nuevo México y Luisiana. Además de equipos petroleros, desde julio los envíos han incluido clínicas portátiles, ambulancias y camiones de bomberos destinados a los campos alrededor de El Tigre, dijo Díaz. Los equipos ingresan a Venezuela por varios puertos, incluido Guanta, a menos de tres horas por carretera hacia el norte, antes de continuar hacia el interior del país. También están llegando nuevos empleados, incluidos de la diáspora venezolana. Empresas como la colombiana GeoPark Ltd., la brasileña Alvorada Oil & Gas y la estadounidense Weatherford International Plc. han enviado personal. Esta última ha multiplicado por diez su fuerza laboral especializada en Venezuela. La india Oil and Natural Gas Corp., brazo internacional de la estatal ONGC Videsh Ltd., envió recientemente un equipo para inspeccionar campos petroleros y revisar activos después de recibir autorización de EE.UU. para reanudar sus operaciones. Algunas compañías esperan asumir el control total de las operaciones y comenzar a trabajar antes de fin de año. Ver más: Inversiones por US$76.000 millones y una espera de más de una década: el horizonte petrolero que plantea Venezuela ONGC Videsh no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios. Los principales hoteles de la ciudad suelen estar completamente reservados y restaurantes que antes permanecían casi vacíos han tenido que incorporar personal y servicios adicionales para atender la demanda. La ocupación de habitaciones en el Eurobuilding El Tigre aumentó a 87% en octubre, desde 35% un año antes, según Eduardo Zarikian, CEO de Eurobuilding Hotels Group. El tráfico de aviones privados también ha aumentado en el aeropuerto a las afueras de El Tigre. Altos ejecutivos han llegado desde empresas ya instaladas, como Chevron Corp. ( CVX ) y North American Blue Energy Partners Inc., así como desde recién llegadas como Primavera Infinita, de Fred Ehrsam, según personas familiarizadas que no estaban autorizadas a hablar públicamente sobre las visitas. Primavera Infinita no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios. Ingenieros colombianos trasladados por GeoPark disfrutan de un lujo que rara vez tenían en regiones petroleras remotas de su país: un trayecto diario de unos 50 minutos por carreteras pavimentadas desde El Tigre hasta los campos cercanos, en lugar de turnos de una semana en campamentos para trabajadores. Pero todavía es pronto. La producción petrolera de Venezuela lleva meses estancada en unos 1,2 millones de barriles diarios, cerca de un tercio de su último máximo sostenido, de unos 3 millones de barriles al día en la década de 1990. Rodríguez afirma que el país espera casi US$76.000 millones en inversiones en petróleo y gas durante los próximos cinco años. Para algunos trabajadores petroleros, la recuperación todavía parece superficial. Yasmina Requena, ingeniera y tasadora de equipos petroleros, señala que las empresas están arrendando terrenos industriales por un año en lugar de cinco. “Están muy cautelosos, como diciendo: ‘Vamos a esperar a ver qué pasa’”. El negocio de las tasaciones avanza lentamente, dijo Requena, de 72 años. En cambio, está viendo muchas ventas de empresas “que no tienen capital para seguir adelante o han canibalizado su propias maquinarias y equipos pero que aun así mantienen su documentación en regla. Están vendiendo lo último que les queda: su razón social”. Ver más: IPC en Venezuela cumple en octubre tres meses a un dígito y así queda la inflación acumulada 2026 El mercado inmobiliario local también está sintiendo el cambio. El precio de un arriendo mensual de una casa amoblada en San Tomé, un suburbio popular entre trabajadores petroleros extranjeros, ha subido de US$1.500 hace un año a US$4.500. El auge también se extiende a la cercana Puerto La Cruz, un centro regional para PDVSA y las petroleras, donde los precios de venta de algunas viviendas han aumentado de US$120.000 a unos US$380.000, dijo Víctor Morales, presidente de la cámara petrolera local. El trabajo en la Faja del Orinoco avanza más rápido que en el lago de Maracaibo porque la mayor parte se realiza en tierra firme, dijo Alexis Medina, director de una empresa de mantenimiento de pozos con sede en la cercana Anaco. Muchas compañías se concentran primero en campos existentes, donde los pozos y la infraestructura pueden rehabilitarse sin las mayores inversiones necesarias para desarrollar áreas aún sin explotar. “Recibimos visitas de firmas internacionales y bancos locales al menos dos veces por semana”, dijo Medina. “Quieren hablar sobre financiamientos, inversión conjunta y préstamos”. En algunos casos, el dinero y los equipos llegan más rápido que los trabajadores capacitados para utilizarlos. Los cursos de certificación para operadores de maquinaria pesada, especialistas en contratos y profesionales ambientales tienen una gran demanda, dijeron ejecutivos del sector. En toda la industria, las empresas están contratando trabajadores, incorporando practicantes universitarios y capacitando equipos para operar maquinaria más moderna tras años de aislamiento tecnológico. “Con IA y herramientas de simulación, estamos creando materiales de capacitación para los nuevos integrantes del equipo, de modo que puedan familiarizarse rápidamente con los equipos que estamos recibiendo”, dijo Dereli, de Denarius Group. El entusiasmo también está llenando los encuentros empresariales en El Tigre y ciudades cercanas. Morales dijo que se agotaron las entradas para la conferencia de noviembre de la cámara petrolera en la ciudad de Lecherías. La entidad ha multiplicado por cinco su número de miembros en cuatro años, hasta alcanzar 110 empresas. Ver más: Riesgo país en Latinoamérica comienza noviembre con Venezuela al alza y Argentina y Ecuador lejos de sus mínimos En los barrios más acomodados de El Tigre se han reactivado proyectos de construcción de viviendas que estaban paralizados y comienzan a verse modelos de automóviles más modernos en las calles. “Las empresas se están desplegando”, dijo Morales. “Pero sólo empezaremos a ver resultados en 2028”. Para muchos residentes, sin embargo, el nuevo auge petrolero de Venezuela no ha mejorado la vida cotidiana. El suministro confiable de agua corriente y electricidad las 24 horas sigue siendo un lujo en algunas zonas de El Tigre, debido al deterioro de los servicios públicos estatales. Los cortes eléctricos suelen dejar fuera de servicio las estaciones de bombeo de agua, pese a que la ciudad se encuentra sobre un gran acuífero. Los centros comerciales todavía tienen oficinas vacías que antes ocupaban bancos, comercios minoristas y pequeñas empresas. “No veo cambios todavía. No se ve dinero en las calles”, dijo Remo Di Marcantonio, propietario de una ferretería local. “Sí, hay más tráfico, pero nada en comparación a hace 20 años atrás”. Di Marcantonio, de 56 años, comenzó a sentir esperanza hace aproximadamente un mes, cuando su sector de la ciudad pasó dos semanas sin apagones. “Parece que alguien importante se quejó y el gobierno puso la electricidad temporalmente. Ahora volvieron los apagones”. Requena, la ingeniera, tiene dificultades para trabajar en medio de las precarias condiciones. “Las aguas negras corren en avenidas principales y calles, y algunos comercios tienen que cerrar. Es horrible”, dijo. “La industria petrolera no es lo que era, para nada. Al menos no todavía”. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: 10月の世界平均気温、観測史上最高 通年は史上2番目か＝ＥＵ機関
item.description: [ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ブリュッセル ６日 ロイター] - 欧州連合（ＥＵ）の気象情報機関「コペルニクス気候変動サービス」は６日、１０月の世界平均気温が１５．３５度となり、観測史上最高だったと明らかにした。２０２６年通年の世界平均気温は産業革命前の水準を１．５度上回り、２４年に次いで観測史上２番目に高くなる可能性が高いとの見通しも示した。２４年と並ぶ、もしくは上回る可能性も約２０％あるという。

コペルニクス気候変動サービスは、「１０月の世界の平均地表気温は産業革命前の水準を１．７５度上回った」と指摘した。

両極圏を除く平均海面水温も２０．９５度となり、１０月としての観測史上最高を記録した。太平洋の赤道付近で海面水温が平年より高くなるエルニーニョ現象が強まっており、１０月まで３カ月連続で１．５度を上回り、２３─２６年までの４年間の平均もそれを超えると見込まれている。

１５年の国際枠組み「パリ協定」で、気温上昇を産業革命前の水準から１．５度以内に抑える目標を掲げる。科学者の間で、これを超える上昇は、深刻な熱波や干ばつ、洪水など、気候関連のリスクを急激に高めるとの指摘がある。

item.title: 米財務長官、中国副首相と経済関係巡り協議 「釜山合意」の履行要求＝財務省
item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - ベセント米財務長官とグリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は、中国の何立峰副首相と両国の経済関係について協議し、釜山で結んだ貿易合意に基づく約束を直ちに履行するよう中国政府に求めた。米財務省が６日明らかにした。

ベセント氏はソーシャルメディアへの投稿で「中国が約束を完全かつ即時に履行することの重要性を強調し、最近の中国の行動に対する懸念を提起するとともに、進展は具体的な成果次第だと指摘した」と述べた。

財務省は声明で、米国は「中国による合意の履行状況を注視する」と述べた。

中国側は、関税の譲歩が依然として主な狙いだとの姿勢を示しており、中国商務省は５日、米国産農産物の購入に前向きだが、双方が相互の関税引き下げで合意することが条件との立場を表明した。

９月にワシントンで行われた中国の習近平国家主席とトランプ米大統領の首脳会談を受けて、両国は６００億ドル規模の相互関税引き下げ案をまとめたが、最終決定に至っていない。

ホワイトハウスは５月、中国が２０２６年から米農産物を年間１７０億ドル購入することで合意したと発表した。今年の目標額は期間に応じて按分される。この購入は昨年１０月に約束した米国産大豆の購入に上乗せされる。

item.title: 米追加利上げ必要の公算、高インフレ抑制へ＝ＳＦ連銀総裁
item.description: [６日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は６日、高すぎるインフレを抑制するため、米連邦準備理事...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米追加利上げ必要の公算、高インフレ抑制へ＝ＳＦ連銀総裁 4:28 配信

米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁。4月9日撮影。REUTERS/Carlos Barria（ロイター） [６日 ロイター] - 米サンフランシスコ地区連銀のデイリー総裁は６日、高すぎるインフレを抑制するため、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）はさらなる利上げが必要になる可能性が高いとの見方を示した。

デイリー氏はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで「政策をさらに引き締める必要があると予想している」と述べた。ただ、具体的な時期や引き上げ幅についてはまだ明確ではないとした。

デイリー氏は、世界は多くの面で非常に不安定に見えるとの見方を示し、「そうした不安定要因は考慮に入れる必要がある」と指摘。その上で、「どこへ向かうべきかが正確に分からない状況では、より多くの情報を収集し、慎重かつ段階的に対応していく必要がある。しかし、さらなる措置が必要になる可能性は高く、経済がそれを求めるのであれば、われわれはそれを実行する用意がある」と述べた。

また、インフレ高止まりが続いている状況に言及し、インフレは最優先課題である必要があると指摘。この日発表の１０月の雇用統計が市場予想を大幅に上回ったことは「朗報」だとし、堅調な労働市場により、ＦＲＢはインフレ対策をやり遂げる余地が生まれているとの見解を示した。

さらに、投資家がＡＩ（人工知能）主導の需要拡大を巡るリスクを再評価する中、ハイテク株の価格は「痛み」を伴いながらも秩序立った形で再評価されていると指摘。その上で、ＡＩの価格再評価が需要鈍化の兆候を示しているのであれば、成長がやや減速する可能性があるとの見方を示した。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：米中間選挙の民主勝利、市場に新たな波乱　外交・財政リスク警戒 焦点：米景気拡大維持、ＦＲＢの利下げペース次第 アングル：米長期金利5％接近で株式市場に警戒感、決算後はマクロ要因に注目 焦点：ベセント氏発言で強まる日銀9月利上げ観測、米国の影響力拡大に懸念も アングル：米国債「ツイスト・スティープ化」、ＦＲＢの信認巡る懸念反映か 11/7(土) 4:28 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Daly, de la Fed, dice que probablemente se necesiten más alzas de tasas para contener los precios
item.description: Daly dijo que respaldó la decisión de la semana pasada de mantener sin cambios la tasa de interés de referencia de la Reserva Federal (Fed), en medio de la incertidumbre sobre la economía.
item.dc:creator: Catarina Saraiva
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — La presidenta del Banco de la Reserva Federal de San Francisco, Mary Daly, afirmó que probablemente se necesiten más aumentos en las tasas de interés para controlar la inflación, pero añadió que era demasiado pronto para saber cuánto más tendrán que subir. “Preveo que tendremos que endurecer aún más las políticas”, declaró Daly el viernes en una entrevista con CNBC. “Aún no se ha decidido exactamente cuándo ni en qué medida, ya que debemos tener en cuenta todas las variables que se presentan”. Ver más: La derrota electoral de Trump podría aliviar la presión política sobre Kevin Warsh y la Fed Daly dijo que respaldó la decisión de la semana pasada de mantener sin cambios la tasa de interés de referencia de la Reserva Federal (Fed), en medio de la incertidumbre sobre la economía. También apoyó la decisión de subir las tasas en septiembre, por primera vez desde 2023. Aunque dos funcionarios de la Fed discreparon de la decisión de mantener las tasas sin cambios el mes pasado porque preferían aumentarlas, varios miembros del organismo han expresado su apoyo a nuevos incrementos, pero de manera gradual. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: China Pressure Drives Taiwan to Shut Papua New Guinea Office and End LNG Purchases
item.description: Taiwan said on Friday it had decided to shut its representative office in Papua New Guinea and stop buying liquefied natural gas from the country, blaming Chinese pressure. Taiwan’s foreign ministry said Papua New Guinea, which briefly had diplomatic relations with Taiwan in 1999, had …
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded:
Taiwan said on Friday it had decided to shut its representative office in Papua New Guinea and stop buying liquefied natural gas from the country, blaming Chinese pressure.

Taiwan’s foreign ministry said Papua New Guinea, which briefly had diplomatic relations with Taiwan in 1999, had repeatedly demanded that staff leave its office in Port Moresby by a set deadline and had pushed for its closure.

Papua New Guinea’s actions “reflect China’s continued use of political pressure and economic influence to interfere in other countries’ diplomatic decisions and suppress Taiwan’s international space”, the foreign ministry added in a statement.

In July, Papua New Guinea’s foreign minister said it had decided to close Taiwan’s representative office immediately, winning praise from China and concern from Washington. The office had, however, remained open in the interim.

The Pacific has long been an area for diplomatic competition between China and Taiwan, which Beijing views as its own territory with no right to the trappings of a state. Taiwan’s government rejects that position.

Neither the Papua New Guinea nor Chinese foreign ministries immediately responded to requests for comment.

Taiwan has formal diplomatic ties with only three Pacific Islands nations: Palau, Tuvalu and the Marshall Islands. It also has a representative office in Fiji. Just 12 countries maintain formal diplomatic ties with Taiwan.

Taiwan’s foreign ministry also said it had stopped buying LNG from Papua New Guinea through the spot market, which in the first half of 2026 was planned for about 500,000 metric tons.

Taiwan will not sign any new spot natural gas purchase contracts with the country in the future, it added.

Taiwan has long been an important market for Papua New Guinea’s natural gas exports, with purchases accounting for roughly a third of total LNG exports, its foreign ministry said.

“So this change in procurement policy will have a substantive impact on Papua New Guinea’s natural gas exports and foreign exchange earnings,” it added.
item.wire:summarySource: The China-Global South Project source metadata

PARIS, Nov 6 : France coach Zinedine Zidane on Friday handed a first call-up to uncapped Paris FC forward Pablo Pagis for their Nations League fixtures against Italy and Turkey, while Aurelien Tchouameni, Ibrahima Konate and Marcus Thuram return to the squad for the first time since the World Cup. • Kylian Mbappe is also back after missing France's last three matches with a knee injury. • Ousmane Dembele, William Saliba, Jules Kounde, Maxence Lacroix, Manu Kone, Maghnes Akliouche and Esteban Lepaul are all ruled out through injuries. • France will face Italy on Thursday in Milan and Turkey on Sunday in Bordeaux.

FAST

CHICAGO, Nov 6 : The US Department of Agriculture will use an artificial intelligence tool it built to check data in next week's monthly crop production report, agency officials said, after a series of data missteps eroded farmers' and traders' trust in its forecasts. After the USDA discovered errors in its corn data from September, officials determined the AI tool would have flagged the problem and decided to use it on the crop production report due on November 10, USDA Under Secretary Scott Hutchins said in an interview. The tool's debut tests whether the agency can restore confidence in data that often moves markets.  "I'm very bullish on the fact that we'll be able to utilize these tools in the future to help us avoid these kinds of really, truly unfortunate errors," Hutchins said on Thursday.

Last month, the USDA corrected its September corn production and yield data. The correction raised the yield estimate by about 3 per cent in Nebraska, the third-biggest corn-producing state, and lowered it by about 2 per cent in Kansas.  The agency, long viewed as the gold standard of global agricultural market information, previously faced criticism after it made sharp upward revisions to estimates for last year's corn acreage. Over the summer, it  reported inaccurate beef export sales data. The USDA previously said it was launching a pilot project that would rely more heavily on technology to improve crop acreage and yield estimates as fewer farmers respond to its surveys.  COMPUTER FILE ERROR  Lance Honig, chair of the agricultural statistics board for USDA's National Agricultural Statistics Service, told Reuters that a computer file incorrectly combined data on irrigated and non-irrigated corn acres gathered by field surveyors, causing the errors in September's data. Kansas and Nebraska were affected because they have higher percentages of irrigated fields, which often have higher yields, he said.  "This error that occurred in September is literally a very isolated occurrence that, quite frankly, with the proper validation, we should have caught," Honig said. "There was no issue with the data that was gathered at the field level." The errors angered farmers who are struggling to make money as they pay soaring prices for diesel, fertilizer and other inputs. Last month, the National Corn Growers Association, which represents 35,000 farmers, said the September errors were unacceptable and had further hurt farmers' confidence in the USDA's ability to produce accurate reports. "You just don't know what the USDA is going to do anymore," said Jim Gerlach, president of brokerage A/C Trading in Indiana, on Friday. "Their reports have become so erratic." Questions around the credibility of federal data increased after President Donald Trump's administration sharply downsized the government last year. Thousands of employees at the USDA have left, and experts have worried the cuts hobbled the agency's ability to produce accurate and timely data. Hutchins said the September errors were not related to staffing losses. The new AI tool will add to, not replace, the agency's data validation, he said.  "The tool is basically going to be used as a check to make sure that there are no anomalies that we were not able to see or identify in the normal process," Hutchins said.       This week, market analysts questioned the accuracy of another monthly USDA report on soy processing which showed a sharp divide between how many soybeans were crushed and how much soymeal was produced in Iowa.  The USDA said it was reviewing the report as part of a normal process and would make any necessary revisions next month.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Federal Reserve rate hike bets strengthen as US jobs growth beats estimates
item.description: Stronger than expected US jobs growth has revived expectations of a December Federal Reserve rate hike, with employers adding 165,000 jobs in October against estimates of 65,000. The unemployment rate fell to 4.1%, while markets raised the probability of a quarter point hike to 85% and brought forward expectations of another increase.
item.dc:creator: ETMarkets.com
item.content:encoded: The Federal Reserve's case for another interest rate hike in December has gained momentum after stronger than expected US employment data reinforced signs of economic resilience, shifting attention back to persistent inflation from concerns over a potential AI driven slowdown, Reuters reported.US employers added 165,000 jobs in October, more than double the 65,000 expected by economists, according to the Bureau of Labor Statistics. The unemployment rate also edged down to 4.1%, suggesting the labour market remains firm despite concerns over the economic outlook.For live updates on US Markets, click here Following the report, markets priced in an 85% probability of a quarter point rate increase at the Fed's December 8-9 meeting, up from around 75% before the data release. Traders also brought forward expectations of another rate increase to April from June, Reuters reported.Strong jobs data reinforce Fed's hawkish outlookThe employment figures strengthen the argument for further monetary tightening as the Fed continues to battle inflation, which has remained above its 2% target for more than five years.Also Read: Nasdaq rebounds as chip stocks recover from steep losses, rate fears persist This is a very strong labor market report on the heels of solid GDP and consumer spending data last week, reinforcing the economy’s positive momentum, Fitch Ratings analyst Olu Sonola wrote after the release.While acknowledging the risks posed by recent AI related concerns, Sonola said the economy remained on firm footing and that labour market resilience was pushing the policy debate towards a December rate hike, Reuters reported.Raymond James analysts also expect the central bank to raise rates next month. For the Federal Reserve, this should allow them to concentrate on the inflation side of their mandate, the analysts wrote. We expect the Fed to increase the federal funds rate by 25 basis points in December. AI concerns had clouded rate outlookExpectations of another rate increase had weakened after Democrats' midterm election gains raised concerns about tighter regulation of AI and data centre construction.The prospect of slower AI investment had fuelled worries about weaker economic growth and easing inflationary pressures, reducing the urgency for further monetary tightening.However, Friday's employment report has renewed expectations that the Fed will prioritise inflation control as it assesses the strength of the US economy.(Disclaimer: This article is based on inputs from agencies. These do not represent the views of The Economic Times)

FAST

Nov 6 : OpenAI will press ahead with its US data-center expansion plans despite a Democratic midterm sweep this week that has fueled fears of tighter scrutiny of the facilities, its Chief Financial Officer Sarah Friar told CNBC in an interview on Friday. "When I think about the midterms, I need to keep thinking about how do we keep investing to meet customer demand," Friar said. "We are going to keep building out those relationships with communities so we can get the compute we need," she added.  One of the corporate faces of the AI boom, OpenAI has moved quickly to counter fears that a shift in congressional power could slow the industry's growth. It launched a charm offensive on Thursday to win over communities as opposition to data centers becomes a rallying point for anxieties about the technology. As part of the efforts, OpenAI said, it will no longer use non-disclosure agreements with public officials when negotiating or discussing future sites. It will also give residents access to construction plans and their potential effects.

Growing data-center opposition was a crucial issue in the midterm elections. Democratic candidates, including Texas Governor-elect Gina Hinojosa, made tighter scrutiny of the facilities a central campaign pledge. The Lone Star State is one of the fastest-growing data-center regions in the world. Fears the Democratic sweep may slow construction of the facilities critical to the AI boom wiped about $2.5 trillion off the US stock market on Thursday, as investors weighed the fallout for the chip, cloud and networking industries that have been among the biggest beneficiaries of the spending frenzy. Still, there are signs that tech giants remain committed to data-center expansion plans despite the growing backlash. Alphabet-owned Google said on Thursday it would invest $17 billion to build its first data center in Wyoming. Meanwhile, Bloomberg News reported that ByteDance is considering expanding a data center project in northeastern Brazil, a move that would strengthen its standing as Latin America's leading builder of computing facilities. OPENAI'S FUNDRAISING PLANS Friar also told CNBC that OpenAI was raising fresh capital, pushing back against suggestions the ChatGPT maker had scaled back its fundraising ambitions amid the sharp AI stocks selloff. The company is seeking fresh capital after its business grew 70 per cent quarter over quarter in the third quarter, with enterprise demand doubling over the same period, she said. "It (the growth) is saying people are actually using AI and getting value from it," Friar said. The fundraising comes as the market turmoil is raising questions about OpenAI rival Anthropic's widely awaited listing. Reuters reported on Thursday that prospective investors in Anthropic's IPO are questioning whether the AI startup can begin its roadshow next week and stay on track for a November listing. Investors are pushing for a more attractive valuation to commit to the offering, with some viewing the recently discussed $1.5 trillion valuation as being at the high end of expectations, four people familiar with investor discussions told Reuters.

Source: Reuters

item.description:
Takahiko Wada
［東京 ７日 ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日（現地時間）、日本企業が人手不足に直...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
国内投資の活発化、企業のリスクテイク「目覚めつつある」＝日銀総裁 2:50 配信

2026年10月12日、渋谷交差点。REUTERS/Kevin Coombs（ロイター） Takahiko Wada

［東京　７日　ロイター］ - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日（現地時間）、日本企業が人手不足に直面して国内投資を活発化していることについて「緩やかな物価上昇の復活に助けられ、企業のリスクテイク姿勢が目覚めつつあるように見受けられる」と述べた。米ワシントンで開催された国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のイベントで講演した。

しかし、経常収支の観点では、巨大な対外純資産により海外投資が国内投資よりも依然として高い収益率を維持しており、第一次所得収支の黒字が「今後何年にもわたり、日本の対外収支の持続的な柱であり続ける」との見通しを示した。

植田総裁は、１９８０年代から続く日本の経常黒字について、企業行動の変化から分析した。

バブル景気崩壊後のバランスシート調整が収束すると、日本企業は高水準の貯蓄を国内の工場建設などに積極的に投じるのではなく、対外直接投資に振り向けた。その理由について、植田総裁は２４年に日銀が実施した調査をもとに、企業経営者が最も頻繁に指摘したのは構造的な「成長期待の低下」だったと述べた。

しかし、最近になって「構造的変化の兆候が具体的に現れ始めている」と指摘。人手不足に直面して企業が国内投資を積極化しており、設備投資は１９９０年代初めのピークを上回ったほか、銀行貸出の伸び率は５％以上に達しているとした。

ただ、「内需主導型の調整」が実現しているのか、その答えは「いまだに明らかにはなっていない」とした。さらなる高齢化による家計の資産取り崩し加速と、企業の設備投資の拡大などが「国内全体の貯蓄と投資のギャップを縮小させる可能性がある」ものの、日本は巨額の対外純資産を蓄積しており「海外投資が国内投資よりも依然として高い収益率を維持しているという状況も続いている」と述べた。

FAST

Nov 6 : Microsoft is winding down an arrangement to rent AI computing from Oracle as part of a larger reassessment of billions of dollars in cloud partnerships, Bloomberg News reported on Friday, citing people familiar with the matter. Shares of Oracle and Microsoft were flat in afternoon trading. Both stocks had come under pressure this week after a Democratic midterm election sweep in the US raised worries about tighter scrutiny that could threaten the AI industry's breakneck expansion. Microsoft had been turning off rented computing capacity from Oracle in recent months after declining to renew the contract, according to the Bloomberg report. The rented computing capacity became less valuable over time as it no longer met Microsoft's evolving needs, the report added, noting that the Oracle hardware used an older generation of Nvidia chips.

"Demand for OCI’s (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) AI infrastructure remains strong, including for earlier-generation GPUs," an Oracle spokesperson told Reuters.  Microsoft did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment. The report adds to signs that Microsoft is rethinking how it secures computing capacity to get more out of its massive AI investments. AI cloud company IREN said on Thursday it had delayed some infrastructure deliveries after Microsoft requested changes to its network design. The move pushed back IREN's target for bringing more than $4 billion in annualized revenue capacity online from year-end to January, with a possible further delay until late February. Earlier on Thursday, Bloomberg News reported Microsoft was tightening oversight of some data center projects run by neocloud providers including IREN, Nebius and Nscale amid delays and rising costs. Oracle had announced the multi-year deal with Microsoft in 2023, saying the Windows maker would use OCI AI infrastructure to power the AI-assisted version of the Bing search engine. The financial terms were not disclosed.

Source: Reuters

item.title: 基調インフレに上振れリスク、2％定着目指す＝日銀総裁
item.description:
Andrea Shalal Leika Kihara
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、日...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
基調インフレに上振れリスク、2％定着目指す＝日銀総裁 2:36 配信

2026年10月30日、日銀の植田和男総裁。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） Andrea Shalal　Leika Kihara

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、日銀は基調的なインフレ率が２％の物価安定目標付近で推移すると見込んでいるものの、一定の上振れリスクがあると認識していると述べた。

植田総裁は国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）主催のイベントで、エネルギー関連製品の価格上昇が消費者物価に影響し始めており、物価上昇率は来年初めにかけてさらに加速する可能性があるとの見方を示した。その上で、賃金上昇率はインフレ率と整合的な水準で推移する均衡状態にあるとし、日銀の現在の目標は基調的なインフレ率を物価目標付近に安定的に定着させることだと指摘。ただ、日本では日銀の２％物価目標がまだ社会規範として定着していないとの認識を示した。

他の国の中央銀行の政策運営については、それぞれが自国経済をどう見ているかについて重要な情報を示しており、それが日本経済にも影響するため、行動や政策を注意深く見守っていると述べた。

非伝統的な金融政策手段については、日銀が導入した際に一定の効果があったとしながらも、プラス金利圏からの利下げを完全に代替するものではなかったとし、日本経済が直面するショックの深刻さ次第では、再び非伝統的な政策手段の導入を余儀なくされる可能性もあると指摘。インフレ率、もしくは基調的なインフレ率を可能な限り２％前後に維持することが重要になるが、非伝統的な政策手段を再び導入する必要が生じた場合は、市場機能への影響も含め、副作用を最小限に抑える方法を考えなければならないと語った。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）のウォーシュ議長による「中央銀行による過度な情報発信」を巡る議論については、中銀は政策目標を市場に伝える必要性と、市場参加者のモラルハザードを招くリスクとの間で適切な均衡を保つ必要があると指摘。日本の場合はこれまで基調的なインフレ率を政策判断の重要な指標として活用してきたとした上で、基調的なインフレ率が２％に達した現在は、その水準を維持することが目標になっていると語った。

植田総裁は人工知能（ＡＩ）の可能性とリスクについても言及。ＡＩの急速な進歩が日本経済の需要を押し上げる効果をもたらしたと述べる一方、供給面の要因も検討する必要があるとの認識を示した。また、日本は深刻な人手不足に直面しているため、ＡＩによる労働代替が進めば恩恵を受ける可能性があるとも述べた。

金融安定の観点からは、サイバーリスクを懸念しているとし、一部の小規模な銀行や企業では、こうしたリスクへの対策が十分ではないと指摘した。

ロイター 関連リンク 焦点：預金から国債へ、「金利ある世界」で個人の動き活発　警戒する銀行 コラム：2027年は円高に転じるか、日銀の利上げ継続と円相場の行方＝内田稔氏 アングル：日銀、基調物価2％定着へ利上げ継続　「次の次」は転換点か コラム：日米金融政策の転換とドル／円の行方＝植野大作氏 コラム：サービス価格上昇に加速の気配、日銀の緩和修正判断に影響も 11/7(土) 4:06 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: Trump meets Putin envoy, says Ukraine peace deal could come very soon
item.description: Trump said he had met Russian envoy Kirill Dmitriev privately and predicted a Ukraine deal could emerge soon, as US officials discussed security guarantees with Kyiv and European partners.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump said he met privately on Thursday with Russian President Vladimir Putin's envoy after the Russian official appeared alongside representatives from Ukraine at a White House event organised by US First Lady Melania Trump. Trump would not disclose what he discussed with Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev but predicted a deal could emerge soon aimed at resolving the Russian war in Ukraine. A US delegation is scheduled to mediate talks in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11 between representatives from Russia and Ukraine. Trump, speaking to reporters at the White House, said the war was close to being settled and that ending it might involve all of Europe. “It's going to be a big agreement, and it's going to involve more than Ukraine ... I could even say it might involve all of Europe. It's going to be a big, beautiful agreement, and everyone's going to be thrilled,” Trump said. Trump has frequently predicted that an agreement to end Europe's deadliest conflict since World War Two was close. However, negotiations have picked up in recent weeks. Trump said he did not meet the Ukrainian delegation on Thursday. Trump envoy Jared Kushner said US officials meeting in Brussels on Thursday held “productive and substantive discussions” with Ukraine, NATO and European partners on security guarantees for Ukraine and a broader European security architecture. Kushner said in a social media post that negotiators were exploring five principal goals: permanent security consultations, reliable crisis communications, greater military transparency, reciprocal measures to reduce escalation risks, and an enduring framework for long-term European security and stability. “Any arrangements must fully respect the sovereignty, territorial integrity, and independent decision-making of every nation,” Kushner said. “Each country will retain authority over its own security and alliances, and no country would have a veto over another's sovereign choices. “NATO will remain central to European collective defence, and this initiative would build upon existing institutions and commitments.” FIRST LADY BRINGS TWO SIDES TOGETHER Dmitriev was among the officials at the rare face-to-face event with Ukrainian representatives at the White House to mark a six-day ceasefire that Melania Trump helped broker in the Russian-controlled city of Oleshky. The deal expired on Sunday. “We have chosen humanity over war,” the First Lady said at the event. “We must use the courage we brought to Oleshky to find common ground through a shared concern for the suffering of innocent people.” Melania Trump said she was “involved in every stage of the planning” of the temporary ceasefire, including reviewing aerial images and assessing roadways and hospital access. President Trump, who did not attend the event, has lauded his wife's role in the Oleshky ceasefire, telling reporters in October that “she does better than our professionals”. Ukrainian lawmaker David Arakhamia and Dmytro Lubinets, the country's human rights ombudsman, also attended the event. They urged Slovenian-born Melania Trump to continue her peace efforts. Both sides presented the First Lady with thank-you gifts. Russia's Dmitriev gave her a drawing of pink hearts from a girl from Oleshky and said the child “chose to live with her family in Russia”, referring to the dispute over displaced Ukrainian children in Russia. “I love Melania,” the drawing read. The Ukrainians presented the First Lady with a state award “for your brave heart, for saving our people, and for returning back Ukrainian children”. She handed the visiting delegations letters addressed to Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy. DEMOCRATS TAKE MAJORITY IN CONGRESS The visit marked the first in-person contact between Russian and US officials since Tuesday's midterm elections, when Democrats ousted Republicans from control of Congress in a blow to Trump. The Democratic majority in Congress, starting in January, is widely expected to push for more aid for Ukraine and question the Republican president's decisions to strike a diesel deal with Russia and ease some sanctions on Moscow. Trump has increased his criticism of Zelenskiy in recent weeks. The Kremlin has said it hopes Trump will continue his peacemaking efforts despite the Republican Party's defeat. It has also said preparations were under way for a meeting between Putin, Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping during the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in China's southern city of Shenzhen this month. Dmitriev previously met Trump's special envoy, Steve Witkoff, at the White House in 2025. Trump's predecessor, Joe Biden, did not invite any Russian officials to the White House. Dmitriev has been involved in facilitating the release of American detainees in Russia, the reunification of Ukrainian children with their families, and the humanitarian operation in Oleshky.

item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

BOJ chief Ueda sees 'some upside risks' to inflation

Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda speaks during a press conference after a BOJ policy meeting in Tokyo, Japan, October 30, 2026. REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/File Photo

07 Nov 2026 01:25AM (Updated: 07 Nov 2026 02:14AM)

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 6 : Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda said on Friday the central bank expects underlying inflation to stay around its 2 per cent target but recognizes there are "some upside risks". The rise in prices of energy-related products was beginning to hit consumer inflation with price growth seen accelerating further into early next year, Ueda said. "We are in an equilibrium with wages growing at a level consistent with 2 per cent inflation," Ueda said at a seminar hosted by the International Monetary Fund. But the BOJ's 2 per cent inflation target has yet to become a social norm in Japan, Ueda said, adding that the central bank's goal now was to anchor underlying inflation around its target.

He also said the BOJ was looking at the actions of other central banks "very, very carefully," as they affect asset prices including foreign exchange rates and interest rates. "What they do reveals important information about what they think about their economies, which will impact our economy. So we look at their behavior and actions very carefully," he said on the policy measures of other central banks. On unconventional monetary policy tools, Ueda said they have had some positive effects when the BOJ deployed them, but added they have not been perfect substitutes for cutting interest rates from positive territory. The BOJ may be obliged to deploy unconventional policy tools again depending on the severity of the economic shock that may hit Japan, Ueda said. "I guess the important thing would be to keep inflation or underlying inflation at around 2 per cent as much as possible. But if we need to deploy these tools again, we should think about ways to minimize negative effects, including possibly the effect on the functioning of the market," he said. Asked about discussions sparked by new Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh about excessive communication, Ueda said central banks needed a good balance between the need to communicate policy goals and the risk of creating a moral hazard on the part of the market. "There has to be a good balance between these considerations," he said, adding that in Japan's case, it had been using underlying inflation as a key variable in guiding policy. Having reached 2 per cent underlying inflation, its goal now was to keep it there, he said. AI, CYBER CHALLENGES Ueda commented briefly on the promise and risks of artificial intelligence, saying rapid advancements in AI had provided a positive demand shock for the Japanese economy, but supply side factors would also need to be studied. Unlike some other countries, Japan could do well with AI replacing labor given its significant labor shortages, he said. IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, noting recent market weakness around AI stocks, said central bankers around the world would need to consider any slowdown in AI-driven growth as they assess steps in their fight against inflation. Georgieva said concerns about dependence on the AI investment boom and high valuations were impacting markets around the world. "Things are going up and down, and this is likely to continue," she told an audience of hundreds at the IMF headquarters in Washington who came to hear Ueda, adding that the volatility would complicate the job of central banks at a time when risks to price stability had been growing. Ueda said he also worried about cyber risks in terms of financial stability, adding that some small banks and small firms had not done enough to guard against such risks.

Source: Reuters

item.title: ＡＩは日本の需要にプラス、供給面も検討必要＝日銀総裁
item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な進歩が日本経済の需要を押し上...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＡＩは日本の需要にプラス、供給面も検討必要＝日銀総裁 2:23 配信

2026年10月30日、日銀の植田和男総裁。REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon（ロイター） [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 日銀の植田和男総裁は６日、人工知能（ＡＩ）の急速な進歩が日本経済の需要を押し上げる効果をもたらしたと述べる一方、供給面の要因も検討する必要があるとの認識を示した。国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）主催のイベントで発言した。

日本は深刻な人手不足に直面しているため、ＡＩによる労働力の代替がうまく進む可能性があると述べた。

金融安定の観点からは、サイバーリスクを懸念しているとし、一部の小規模な銀行や企業では、こうしたリスクへの対策が十分ではないと指摘した。

item.title: Un yate, aviones y carros de lujo: los bienes incautados a Miguel Vázquez, dueño de Ueno Bank en Paraguay
item.description: La Fiscalía paraguaya incautó nueve vehículos de alta gama, un yate de fabricación italiana y dos aeronaves en el marco de la investigación contra Miguel Vázquez, principal accionista de Grupo Vázquez ...
item.dc:creator: Carlos Cuevas
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg Línea — La Fiscalía General y la Policía Nacional de Paraguay han estado incautando los bienes de Miguel Fernando Vázquez Villasanti, CEO de Grupo Vázquez, conglomerado empresarial del que hace parte Ueno Bank, que ha estado en el ojo del huracán la última semana. Entre los bienes confiscados sobresalen un yate de la fabricante italiana Azimut Yachts y dos avionetas: una modelo Beechcraft King Air 300 y otra Beechcraft B55. Durante una serie de allanamientos a las propiedades de Vázquez en la capital de Paraguay, Asunción, y San Juan del Paraná, también fueron secuestrados nueve vehículos de alta gama, que fueron retirados del lugar en grúas y entregados a la Secretaría Nacional de Administración de Bienes Incautados y Comisados (Senabico), según la Fiscalía. Ver más: Estos son los pasos del juicio político contra Santiago Peña en Paraguay Vázquez, de 36 años, está imputado en una causa por la presunta comisión de conducta indebida en situaciones de crisis, lesión de confianza, tentativa de estafa y violación de la obligación de llevar libros de comercio. “La imputación del Ministerio Público remarca que en el marco de las actuaciones del ente bancario se habría gestado un esquema financiero dentro y fuera del holding de Ueno Bank, que se habría aliado a varias empresas que tenían los mismos directivos, domicilios, operadores y que esa práctica generó un daño patrimonial”, dice la Fiscalía de Paraguay en un comunicado. Ueno Bank, el sexto banco más grande de Paraguay por volumen de depósitos, fue intervenido el 3 de noviembre luego de que el Banco Central detectara que su índice había caído por debajo del 50% del mínimo requerido. Después de la intervención, Ueno congeló el dinero de los usuarios, hecho que desencadenó protestas masivas en Asunción contra la entidad financiera y el presidente paraguayo, Santiago Peña, quien presentó su renuncia al cargo el jueves, pero el Congreso no la aceptó. Quienes cuestionan la gestión de Peña sostienen que incurrió en conflictos de intereses al utilizar su posición como presidente para favorecer a Ueno Bank, con el que tuvo vínculos patrimoniales hasta comienzos de 2025. Vázquez Villansanti, por su parte, es un empresario especializado en Finanzas, Gestión Empresarial y Transformación Digital en INCAE Business School. También completó el Programa de Alta Dirección del IAE, un programa ejecutivo de Marketing en la Universidad de Miami y cursos en Harvard y Singularity University. De acuerdo con la composición accionaria publicada por Grupo Vázquez en abril de 2026 , el empresario posee el 75,94% del capital y concentra el 94,02% de los derechos de voto. El control de Ueno Bank se ejerce mediante U Holdings, sociedad constituida en Luxemburgo, y U Paraguay, accionista mayoritario del banco. Según un informe de la calificadora FIX del 3 de noviembre, Grupo Vázquez posee el 86,7% de U Holdings, mientras U Paraguay concentra el 91,21% del capital de Ueno Bank. El Congreso debía aceptar o rechazar la decisión de Santiago Peña en la tarde del jueves, pero no pudo hacerlo por falta de quórum. El motivo: conforme avanzaba la sesión y parecía que los votos por el rechazo iban a ganar, la bancada del oficialista Partido Colorado abandonó la sala. De esta manera, pese a que intentó dimitir, Peña continúa siendo presidente de Paraguay. Si el Congreso hubiera aceptado su renuncia, Peña se habría convertido automáticamente en senador vitalicio y, por ende, disfrutaría de un fuero constitucional que dificultaría un proceso penal inmediato en su contra. Ver más: Qué pasó y por qué renunció Santiago Peña, el presidente de Paraguay También el jueves, la Cámara de Diputados aprobó de manera unánime un juicio político contra Peña, proceso que debe continuar en la Cámara del Senado este viernes y definirá si lo destituyen de su cargo. Si Peña es destituido, no gozaría de fuero constitucional y podría ser juzgado como cualquier paraguayo por las acusaciones relacionadas con la intervención al quebrado Ueno Bank, que detenó en el bloqueo de los depósitos de los ahorradores. Hoy, viernes, se adelanta una de las al menos cinco sesiones que hacen parte del juicio político contra Peña y que está transmitiendo el Senado en vivo.

item.title: Nubank suspende depósitos y retiros de criptomonedas en Brasil por problema de un proveedor externo
item.description: La fintech brasileña aseguró que los activos y la información de sus clientes siguen protegidos y que el incidente no está relacionado con su infraestructura. El resto de sus servicios cripto opera co ...
item.dc:creator: Matheus Piovesana
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Nu Holdings Ltd. ( NU ) suspendió temporalmente los depósitos y retiradas de criptomonedas en Brasil debido a un problema con un proveedor externo, una semana después de que unos piratas informáticos robaran US$6.300 millones a Binance Holdings Ltd. “Todos los activos y la información siguen estando protegidos”, afirmó la empresa el viernes en un comunicado en el que no identificó al socio comercial. El problema “no está relacionado con la infraestructura de la empresa y no pone en peligro la seguridad de los clientes”. Nubank, como se conoce a la empresa, señaló que el resto de productos relacionados con las criptomonedas funcionan con normalidad. Ver más: Nubank lanza herramienta de IA que promete recomendaciones de inversión imparciales La empresa fintech, que cuenta con unos 120 millones de clientes en Brasil, no reveló cuántos de ellos se vieron afectados por la suspensión. Binance está restableciendo gradualmente los servicios de retirada de fondos para algunos activos, según indicó el viernes en una publicación en redes sociales. A principios de semana, la empresa brasileña Mercado Bitcoin Serviços Digitais Ltda. anunció que absorbería unas pérdidas de US$40 millones tras sufrir un ataque informático. FAST

LONDON: Bomb threats warning "the clock is ticking" were sent to TV stations across Europe on Friday (Nov 6), prompting evacuations and programming to be suspended. Warning s were sent to Irish broadcaster RTE, Britain's Sky, Bulgarian private station Nova TV and others, the companies said. No bomb s were found at any affected site. RTE programmes were replaced by music and a pre-recorded message, some for as long as three hours. The alerts follow a string of hoax bomb threats that has disrupted passenger flights from Serbia to Finland to Spain and beyond in recent days, forcing diversions, emergency landings and security sweeps, though no explosives have been found so far. They also come amid a growing sense of unease about hacking scams in recent weeks, including cyberattacks on supermarkets .

"We want the whole world to know about us, which is why one of our operatives has planted an explosive device in your building," read one email received by Nova and RTE on Friday. "It will detonate in 45 minutes. The clock is ticking."

EMAILS TITLED "MESSAGE TO THE WEST" It is unclear who was behind Friday's hoaxes. The emails to RTE and Nova were signed off with the name Mikhail Andropov, with a message saying the author was one of the leaders of a group responsible for this week's plane hoaxes. "But this is only the beginning. What happened this week is just a small part of what awaits Europe in the near future," the message added. The purported author shared a surname with Yuri Andropov, a former General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union. The title of the email “MESSAGE TO THE WEST,” echoed the title of a biography of Andropov called “New Challenge to the West”. It was unclear if this was a sign of Russian involvement, or an attempt to point the finger at Moscow.

Related:

Fighter jet escorts, flight diversions: What we know about Europe’s wave of hoax bomb threats

Japan launches emergency cybersecurity package after wave of attacks

Police came to the Nova newsroom in Sofia, which was evacuated, checked and deemed safe. Broadcasting was not interrupted and employees returned to their desks, broadcasters said. Staff returned to RTE's campus after police completed a more than three-hour sweep of the buildings. Irish Prime Minister Micheal Martin said security agencies in Europe had not yet determined whether the threats to air travel and media organisations were being made by individuals or as part of a coordinated attack. "It just illustrates how relatively simple it can be to cause disruption and to undermine the normal operation of society through unconventional activities of this kind, which are designed to cause disruption, designed to cause fear and anxiety," Martin told RTE radio shortly after news programming went back on air from an outside broadcasting unit. "We have to remain calm," he added.

Source: Reuters/fs

AI rout sets off market alarm signals as traders brace for what's next

FAST

LONDON, Nov 6 : A rout in technology stocks as confidence in the AI trade falters could test the resilience of global financial markets from New York to Taipei. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 rose nearly 2 per cent on Friday, clawing back some of Thursday's more than 6 per cent plunge - but traders remain on edge. Policymakers have long warned of the risks from an AI boom unraveling. Investors and regulators are keeping a close watch on market stress indicators, with some flashing amber, although not yet red. Here's a look at how key measures are faring:

FEAR IS UP Wall Street's fear gauge, the VIX index of US stock market volatility, rose to over 28 on Thursday, its highest since late March. It was holding close to that level on Friday. The increase is relatively contained compared to the post-April 2025 "Liberation Day" market jump and the August 2024 market selloff. Still, the VIX has surged more than 40 per cent this week. The European equivalent hit its highest level since May on Friday. "It's still early days," said Idanna Appio, a portfolio manager at First Eagle Investments. "My concern would be if we see more spikes in volatility, more stress, real issues with the ability to access markets. Those will be the things that...I'll be watching." PROTECTION FROM TECH TREMORS Perhaps the biggest harbinger of potential trouble in the AI space is a surge in insurance protection against a debt default. The cost of insuring debt issued by neocloud firm CoreWeave has spiked into distressed territory, with five-year credit default swap (CDS) spreads surging past 1,000 basis points to record highs. It has become a barometer of investor anxiety over AI. Spreads on credit default swaps for SpaceX and Intel have also jumped this week. The premium investors demand to hold US high yield corporate credit, known as junk bonds, has risen to its highest since the Liberation Day ructions as traders cool on riskier assets. In the riskiest parts of the market, for companies rated CCC or lower, that premium is trading at around its highest since 2020, according to ICE BofA indices. INVESTORS SEEK SAFETY A flight to safe havens is a clear sign of increased market angst, although daily moves are also relatively modest. US 10-year Treasury yields have fallen 50 bps from peaks above 5 per cent hit last month on concerns about high debt, rising inflation and competition for capital as tech firms ramped up bond sales. Currency markets were relatively muted, but there were some signs of investors seeking the US dollar, which was up 0.6 per cent as of 1500 GMT on Friday. Three-month euro cross-currency basis swaps, or the relative premium for swapping foreign currencies into dollars, briefly touched -8 bps on Thursday, the lowest since late 2023, signaling increased demand for dollar funding. It had recovered slightly on Friday to around -6 bps. BofA's Flow Show report on Friday said cash funds saw a $140 billion inflow in the week to Wednesday, the seventh biggest on record. BONDS BEHAVE Bond markets are so far showing no signs of the sort of stress they came under during the COVID-19 pandemic or around the Liberation Day tariffs. The closely watched MOVE index, which tracks volatility in the US Treasury market, hit a six-month high in October but has since slipped back. Other bond-market measures such as US swap spreads, which can indicate funding and liquidity stress, have also remained calm.

Source: Reuters

WASHINGTON, Nov 6 : Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda on Friday said rapid advancements in artificial intelligence had provided a positive demand shock for the Japanese economy, but supply side factors would also need to be studied. Ueda, speaking at an event hosted by the International Monetary Fund, said Japan could do well with AI replacing labor given its significant labor shortages. He said he worried about cyber risks in terms of financial stability, adding that some small banks and small firms had not done enough to guard against such risks.

FAST

SAO PAULO, Nov 6 : McLaren's Lando Norris set the pace in first practice for Formula One's Sao Paulo Grand Prix on Friday, with newly crowned world champion Kimi Antonelli second fastest in his first track session since sealing the title in Mexico last weekend. Norris, who dominated at Interlagos last year on his way to the 2025 championship, topped the timesheets with a lap of one minute 11.717 seconds. Mercedes' Antonelli was 0.082 slower, with Red Bull's four-times world champion Max Verstappen third, 0.236 off the pace. Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton was fourth fastest, ahead of Mercedes' George Russell, who is due to serve a grid penalty this weekend as the team chase the constructors' championship. Mercedes can secure the title at Interlagos if they outscore Ferrari by three points.

"We felt like this was a good place to take it," Russell said in comments shared by Mercedes on social media, noting that his former teammate Hamilton had recovered strongly from a grid penalty at Interlagos in the past. Antonelli, who clinched the championship last Sunday with third place in Mexico, headed back on track at a venue where he scored what was then his best Formula One finish with second place last year. Brazilian Rafael Camara, replacing Esteban Ocon at Haas, took his first outing in a 2026 car ahead of his home race and finished 18th, with a lap of one minute 13.696 seconds. Local fans also had Gabriel Bortoleto to cheer on, marking the first time since 2016 that there were two Brazilian drivers on the grid. The Audi driver ended the session eighth fastest. A red flag interrupted running early on when Audi stand-in Freddie Slater stopped on track after reporting a gearbox problem. "The car has just switched off... I've lost the gears," the Briton told the team over the radio. Slater, who endured limited running in Mexico last week, completed only seven laps and finished last. Ferrari junior Dino Beganovic, driving in place of Charles Leclerc, also suffered a difficult session. The Swede ran off track early before mechanics repaired the floor of his car, leaving him 21st after completing only 11 laps. Hamilton reported slippery conditions over the radio despite dry weather, with rain forecast later in the weekend at a circuit renowned for producing dramatic wet races. Several drivers, including Hamilton, Antonelli and Camara, briefly ran wide at Turn One, while Verstappen complained about his car's downshifts, describing them as "unacceptable" over team radio. Alpine's Gabriele Mini impressed with seventh place on the timesheets, ahead of Bortoleto and Argentine teammate Franco Colapinto.

Source: Reuters

item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事は６日、世界の中央銀行はインフレ抑...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
世界の中銀、ＡＩ主導成長の減速考慮必要＝ＩＭＦ専務理事 1:53 配信

１０月１６日撮影　REUTERS/Patipat Janthong（ロイター） [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 国際通貨基金（ＩＭＦ）のゲオルギエワ専務理事は６日、世界の中央銀行はインフレ抑制に向けた政策運営を判断する際、ＡＩ（人工知能）主導の経済成長が減速する可能性を考慮する必要があると述べた。

ゲオルギエワ氏はＩＭＦ本部で行った講演で、ＡＩ投資ブームへの依存や高水準の株価評価に対する懸念が世界の金融市場に影響を及ぼしていると指摘。「市場は上昇と下落を繰り返しており、この状況は今後も続く可能性が高い」と述べ、物価安定を巡るリスクが高まる中、こうした市場の変動性で中銀の政策運営が一段と複雑になる可能性があるとの見方を示した。

item.title: 米民主党、ＡＩ規制法案を多数提出へ 共和党路線から転換
item.description:
Courtney Rozen
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 来年１月から米連邦議会の主導権を握る民主党は、人工知...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米民主党、ＡＩ規制法案を多数提出へ　共和党路線から転換 1:52 配信

2026年3月21日、米カリフォルニア州サンフランシスコで行われた、AI開発の一時停止を求めるデモ。REUTERS/Manuel Orbegozo（ロイター） Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 来年１月から米連邦議会の主導権を握る民主党は、人工知能（ＡＩ）システムやデータセンター開発を規制対象とする多数の新法案を提出する計画だ。議員や議会スタッフ、政策提言に携わる関係者らが明らかにした。

この計画は、共和党主導の議会からの大きな転換を示すものだ。共和党主導の議会は主にＡＩ開発の促進に力を入れ、有権者がデータセンターの急速な開発とその膨大な電力需要に反発する中でも、技術の一部を制限する法案の可決を見送ってきた。

関係者によると、民主党はデータセンターに伴う電気料金の上昇から消費者を守る法案、先端ＡＩシステムに第三者による検証を義務付ける法案、ＡＩ企業が製品による損害の責任を問われる条件を明確にする法案を提出する計画だ。

こうした法案は、共和党のトランプ米大統領がホワイトハウスにとどまる間は成立が極めて難しい。トランプ氏はＡＩ技術に関する義務的な規則の策定を求める声を繰り返し退けてきたためだ。

トランプ氏は６日、ＡＩを取り入れて「豊かになりたい」州と協力する意向を示したが、詳細は明らかにしなかった。

ただ、民主党議員や党外の提言者らは、議会委員会を掌握することで、党が提案を前進させ、業界トップに証言を強く求めるとともに、ＡＩシステムが現実に損害を引き起こした場合に行動への支持を固める足場を得られると指摘した。テキサス州選出の民主党下院議員で、議会進歩派連盟（プログレッシブ・コーカス）の議長を務めるグレッグ・キャサー氏は、ＡＩ企業の幹部を宣誓の上で証言するよう求めるべきだと述べている。

連邦政府がＡＩ開発に規制をかければ、新モデルの公開を遅らせたり、製品が人々に害を及ぼしているとの懸念に対応するためＡＩツールの機能変更を迫ったりすることで、業界の収益を損なう可能性がある。

ＡＩに対する世間の懸念は既に高い。１０月に発表されたロイターの世論調査によると、米国の有権者の大半は、トランプ政権と議会がＡＩのリスクを十分に深刻に受け止めていないと考えており、政府がこの技術に関する新たな規制を策定することを望んでいる。

レイモンド・ジェームズで政策調査を統括するエド・ミルズ氏は、危機が起きれば、ＡＩ規制への大統領の反対を乗り越えるだけの支持を固められる可能性があるとし、「法案が成立する確率は、人々が予想しているよりもはるかに高い」と語った。

議会は上下両院でそれぞれ３分の２の議員の支持を得れば、大統領の拒否権を覆すことができる。ミルズ氏は、民主党は毎年議会を通過させなければならない定例法案にＡＩ規制を盛り込もうとする可能性もあると指摘した。

民主党はさらに、オープンＡＩやアンソロピックを含むＡＩ開発業界で最も強い影響力を持つ企業への監視を強める計画だ。ロフグレン氏ら民主党の下院委員会幹部は１０月、オープンＡＩ、アンソロピック、メタ、アルファベット傘下のグーグル、スペースＸに対し、セキュリティー対策の詳細を説明するとともに、ＡＩツールが設計者の意図しない行動を取った事例を報告するよう求めた。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ規制懸念で株価急落、パニック売り後のリバウンドへの思惑も アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 アングル：「身体を持つＡＩ」、中国ロボット業界が巨額投資　米企業と競争激化 11/7(土) 1:52 最終更新 ロイター

FAST

BARCELONA, Nov 6 : Spanish opposition leader Alberto Nunez Feijoo says he would be willing to withdraw Spain as a host of the 2030 World Cup should FIFA award the final to Morocco, amid a fierce battle between the two countries to accommodate football's biggest match. FIFA are yet to declare a venue for the final of the 2030 World Cup, hosted by Morocco, Portugal and Spain. Feijoo, who leads the conservative Popular Party, said on Thursday that it was "inarguable" that Spain should host the event. "Spain must host the World Cup final. And if it doesn't, in my opinion, Spain shouldn't take part in organising the World Cup," said Feijoo in an interview with TV programme El Chiringuito. When asked if he would look to withdraw Spain as a host if he were in power, Feijoo responded, "Yes, the answer is yes."

Feijoo is the main opposition to socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez, who said in a September interview with Cadena SER that he was "working for it (the final) to be held in Spain". Spain men's national team manager Luis de la Fuente told a press conference on Friday that he had made his opinion clear that "the final should be played in Spain". Royal Moroccan Football Federation President Fouzi Lekjaa claimed at an event in September that Casablanca would have the "honour of hosting the 2030 World Cup final," although Moroccan Prime Minister Aziz Akhannouch said the matter had not been discussed with Spain and Portugal. FIFA told Reuters in September that the World Cup final venue will be decided 'in due course' and this month began visiting candidate cities in Spain, Portugal and Morocco to assess their suitability to host matches.

Source: Reuters

item.description: 台湾、パプアニューギニアの代表処閉鎖へ 「中国が干渉」と主張 Reuters

item.title: 台湾、パプアニューギニアの代表処閉鎖へ 「中国が干渉」と主張
item.description: ［台北 ６日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［台北　６日　ロイター］ - 台湾外交部（外務省）は６日、パプアニューギニアにある代表処（窓口機関）を閉鎖することを決定したと発表した。パプア側から執拗に閉鎖を迫られていたといい、「中国が政治的圧力や経済的影響力を使って他国の外交上の決定に干渉し、台湾の国際的な活動の場を抑圧していることの表れだ」と主張した。

台湾は、パプアからの液化天然ガス（ＬＮＧ）の購入を停止することも明らかにした。

パプアのトカチェンコ外相は今年７月、同国の台湾の代表処の即時閉鎖を発表。中国は称賛する一方、米政権からは懸念の声が上がっていた。台湾外交部によると、代表処の職員に対し、期限までに退去するよう要求が繰り返され、閉鎖を迫られていたという。

太平洋地域は長年、中国と台湾の間の外交の争いの場となってきた。台湾と正式な外交関係を維持しているのは１２カ国にとどまり、このうち、太平洋島しょ国ではパラオ、ツバル、マーシャル諸島の３カ国。フィジーには代表処がある。パプアは１９９９年に短期間、台湾と外交関係を持っていた。

台湾外交部は、スポット市場を通じたＬＮＧ購入を停止し、新たな購入契約は結ばないと説明した。パプアのＬＮＧ総輸出の約３分の１を占める台湾は、パプアにとって天然ガスの主要輸出先となっていた。

item.description:
Howard Schneider
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は６日、...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
インフレなお最大の懸念事項、適時な抑制必要＝米セントルイス連銀総裁 1:03 配信

２０２５年５月９日撮影　 REUTERS/Ann Saphir（ロイター） Howard Schneider

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米セントルイス地区連銀のムサレム総裁は６日、同地区連銀が管轄する中西部地区の企業との対話で、インフレが依然として最大の懸念事項になっていると述べた。

ムサレム総裁は「インフレは経済を歪める『逆進的な税』だ」とし、「経済成長と雇用のためにわれわれができる最善のことは、インフレ率を適時に引き下げることだ」と語った。

ムサレム総裁は今年の連邦公開市場委員会（ＦＯＭＣ）で投票権を持っていないが、利上げを支持している。

ＦＲＢは１０月のＦＯＭＣで金利据え置きを決定したが、次回１２月８─９日のＦＯＭＣでは追加利上げに動くとの見方が強まっている。

item.description: [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が６日発表した１１月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は５１．０と１０月...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ミシガン大消費者信頼感、11月速報値51に改善　ＡＩバブル警戒の声も 0:48 配信

米ニューヨーク市で食料品を購入する人々。8月26日撮影。REUTERS/Jeenah Moon（ロイター） [ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - 米ミシガン大学が６日発表した１１月の消費者信頼感指数（速報値）は５１．０と１０月の４８．０（確定値）から上昇した。景況感は改善したものの、生活費の高騰に対する懸念は根強く、家計が人工知能（ＡＩ）バブルの可能性を警戒していることも分かった。

信頼感の改善は、無党派層に集中した。輸入関税やイラン戦争に起因するインフレ高止まりを背景に、トランプ大統領率いる共和党は３日の中間選挙で民主党に議会の支配権を奪還された。

消費者調査ディレクターのジョアン・スー氏は、「低中所得層の信頼感は上向いたが、株式市場が乱高下したことを受け、株式ポートフォリオが最も大きい層では景況感が５％低下した」と指摘。その上で「さらに、消費者のコメントからは、ＡＩバブルの可能性に対する不安が高まっていることも分かった」と述べた。

１年先のインフレ期待は４．３％と、前月の４．７％から低下した。５年先のインフレ期待は３．４％と、前月の３．５％から小幅低下した。

調査は１０月２０日から１１月２日にかけて実施された。

ロイター 関連リンク アングル：ＡＩ規制懸念で株価急落、パニック売り後のリバウンドへの思惑も アングル：巧妙化するサイバー攻撃、攻撃する側もされる側も「ＡＩ武装」 アングル：世界市場は既にぜい弱、ＡＩにもひび割れ 焦点：オープンＡＩの甘いセキュリティー管理、従業員は以前から警鐘 アングル：「身体を持つＡＩ」、中国ロボット業界が巨額投資　米企業と競争激化 11/7(土) 0:48 最終更新 ロイター

item.title: トランプ政権、科学技術諮問委の会合延期 メタやエヌビディアＣＥＯがメンバー
item.description:
Courtney Rozen
[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Courtney Rozen

[ワシントン ６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領政権は、半導体大手エヌビディアのジェンスン・フアン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）やメタ・プラットフォームズのマーク・ザッカーバーグＣＥＯが参加するホワイトハウスの科学技術諮問委員会の６日の会合を延期した。エネルギー省の報道官が明らかにした。

６日には、ＡＩ政策などを助言する大統領科学技術諮問委員会（ＰＣＡＳＴ）の会合開催が予定されていた。同委員会には、ＡＭＤのリサ・スーＣＥＯや、アンドリーセン・ホロウィッツの共同創業者マーク・アンドリーセン氏も参加している。共同議長は、ベンチャーキャピタリストのデビッド・サックス氏とホワイトハウスの技術顧問マイケル・クラツィオス氏が務める。

エネルギー省のウェブサイトには、新たな会合日として１１月１３日が一時記載されていたが、同省はその後、これを撤回する電子メールを送信した。

ハイテク株は５日、中間選挙での民主党の圧勝を受け、新連邦議会がＡＩ開発を減速させるとの懸念の高まりや、ＡＩ構築に向けた巨額の設備投資が十分なリターンをもたらさないとの不安から急落した。市場の混乱を受け、大手テック企業の経営幹部と政府の政策立案者の双方で同セクターに対する監視の目が強まっている。

延期の理由について、ホワイトハウスはコメント要請にすぐには応じなかった。

item.title: Street remains bullish on Titan Company post Q2, stronger Q3 prospects
item.description: Analysts remain positive on Titan after its Q2 earnings, citing resilient jewellery demand, improving watch and eyewear performance, and stronger festive prospects in Q3 ...
item.dc:creator: Devangshu Datta
item.content:encoded: Tata group jewellery-to-watches retailer Titan Company’s consolidated revenue from operations grew 10 per cent year-on-year (Y-o-Y) to ₹20,610 crore in the second quarter of financial year 2026-27 (Q2FY27); excluding bullion, growth would be 23 per cent. Standalone jewellery revenue (ex-bullion) rose 22 per cent Y-o-Y, though demand was impacted by the festive season’s shift from Q2 in FY26 to Q3 in FY27. (This will also impact Q3FY27 comparisons). Volatile gold prices also impacted sales. Footfalls improved at the end of October 2026. Q3FY27 may see growth with a boost from festive buying. Stable gold prices may improve margins and volumes.

item.title: Sebi warns Dabur India over delay in disclosing USFDA warning letter
item.description: The market regulator has cautioned Dabur India over delayed disclosure of a USFDA warning letter, saying repeated violations could attract enforcement action under Sebi rules.
item.dc:creator: Sharleen Dsouza
item.content:encoded: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) on Friday issued a warning to Dabur India for delaying the disclosure of a warning letter issued by the US Food and Drug Administration (USFDA) in July, the company said in a stock exchange filing. In its letter, the market regulator noted that the non-compliance was viewed seriously and advised the company’s board to be careful in the future to avoid lapses. “Any repetition of such violation in future will be viewed seriously and appropriate enforcement action would be initiated in accordance with the provisions of the SEBI Act, 1992, the Rules, the Regulations or Circulars issued thereunder,” said the letter, which the company uploaded on the exchanges. The letter added that the communication from Sebi should be placed before the board of directors at the upcoming board meeting and its comments should be forwarded to the regulator. Dabur India said that the warning letter issued by Sebi had no impact on the company's financial operations and other activities.

item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Firefly inks $1.3 billion deal to supply engines for new AST SpaceMobile 'Blacklift' rocket

FILE PHOTO: A screen displays the Firefly Aerospace logo during the company's IPO at the Nasdaq MarketSite in New York City, U.S., August 7, 2025. REUTERS/Jeenah Moon/File Photo

FAST

WASHINGTON, Nov 6 : Firefly Aerospace will supply core engines for a new rocket under development by satellite communications firm AST SpaceMobile in a $1.3 billion deal, underscoring a push among satellite companies to secure access to space. The engine deal, announced on Friday, is a key part of new plans by AST SpaceMobile to develop its own rocket named Blacklift as it races to deploy a satellite constellation for global cellular broadband service and wean itself off a reliance on third-party rockets like SpaceX's Falcon 9. Firefly will build and supply 27 of its new Miranda engines and 9 in-space Vira engines for the first three Blacklift rockets, per the agreement, which also grants a license to AST to eventually manufacture the engines itself. Shares of Firefly were up about 18 per cent following the announcement of the deal, while AST SpaceMobile's stock was up about 1 per cent.
